policy_title: Reaffirm British sovereignty and reject international influence
stated: Reform UK will reaffirm British sovereignty by rejecting the influence of the World Economic Forum, rejecting the World Health Organisation (WHO) Pandemic Treaty, and cancelling WHO membership unless there is fundamental reform. They also oppose the creation of a Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) and a cashless society.

source.quote: Reaffirm British Sovereignty Reject the influence of the World Economic Forum. Reject the World Health Organisation (WHO) Pandemic Treaty and cancel our membership of the WHO unless there is fundamental reform to its structure and funding. Reform UK also opposes the Creation of a Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC). We oppose a cashless society.

bearing_set.reason: Cancelling WHO membership and rejecting the Pandemic Treaty would plausibly reduce UK access to international health surveillance, vaccine procurement coordination, and pandemic-response frameworks, with a non-negligible effect on healthcare capacity during future health crises.

Opposition to a Central Bank Digital Currency is explicitly grounded in privacy and civil-liberties concerns — government-programmable money enabling transaction surveillance sits squarely within O9's scope of privacy and free exercise of rights.

Cancelling/suspending WHO membership removes UK access to global disease-surveillance networks (GOARN, IHR), early-warning systems and coordinated pandemic-response infrastructure — a concrete mechanism affecting the 'resilience to external threats' indicator.

Opposing a CBDC and cashless society directly prevents a new state instrument enabling transaction-level surveillance and programmable spending controls, improving financial privacy and freedom from state coercion; the WHO-treaty rejection is also framed as blocking externally-driven coercive health mandates (lockdowns, vaccination requirements), mapping to bodily autonomy under O10.

membership_note: WEF rejection is largely symbolic with no identifiable concrete mechanism moving any indicator. The CBDC/cashless and WHO components carry real, traceable effects on national health-security resilience (O5) and personal liberty/financial privacy (O10), warranting those two bearings.
